channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Cupid Parasite
item.description: In finding love for the Parasite 5, will Cupid find love herself?

item.title: Graveyard Keeper - Better Save Soul
item.description: We're all sinners - as the Bishop in the Town teaches us. Our new acquaintance Euric though is set on proving the opposite. And he will of course need the help of the Graveyard Keeper! Prepare your tools, your charm, and put your mind to work on a mission to save souls!

item.title: Graveyard Keeper - Stranger Sins
item.description: In the first big storyline DLC you will have to build your own tavern and dive into the past of the world of Graveyard Keeper. Discover secrets of the locals. Find out more about the ruins are in the Village. What is the ancient curse? Where did the Ancient Contract come from?

item.title: Le Mans Ultimate - US Track Pack 2
item.description: The second US Track Pack is here! Including Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta and the Streets of Long Beach Circuit. 2 tracks, 2 distinct personalities!

item.title: Nocturne
item.description: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

item.title: Returns Outlet Simulator
item.description: Build an Empire from Pallet Returns! Buy mystery pallets of customer returns, uncover hidden treasures, and fix broken electronics! Manage your own outlet store and take risks to turn someone else's returns into your pure profit!

item.title: Surgeon Simulator 2
item.description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ in this physics-based surgery sim. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

item.title: Tick Tock: A Tale for Two
item.description: You and your friend are trapped in a mystical world. As time ebbs away you must solve increasingly complex puzzles to escape. Cooperation is key as neither of you have the full picture! Play on two devices, local or remotely, all you need is a voice connection.

item.title: Beat Saber
item.description: Slash the beats, get moving, and experience the world's most popular VR rhythm game!* Duck, dodge, and flow through 300+ handcrafted songs from artists like Coldplay, Imagine Dragons, and Metallica. Play solo, compete online, or pass the headset at your next party. Jump in with 60+ songs included!

item.title: eXoSpace Combat Engineer
item.description: Snap, rotate and launch your own warship in minutes, then pilot it into bullet-hell boss fights to hunt the galaxy's supervillains. Master intuitive engineering, evolve from drone to dreadnought, and use the fully gridless designer to build anything you can imagine!

item.title: False Hero
item.description: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

item.title: Gravebound
item.description: Gravebound is a 6-player co-op extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by rogue machines. Scavenge valuable loot, survive intense firefights, complete dynamic objectives, and extract alive to keep what you earn. Push deeper for rarer rewards, tougher enemies, and higher stakes.

item.title: Medieval Dynasty - Hunting Set
item.description: Demonstrate your hunting skills with the Hunting Pack DLC! Choose between special outfits, grab one of the unique weapons, and prove to everyone you are the best hunter around. Let the hunt begin with the set of new legendary items.

item.title: Nighthawks
item.description: The secret is out. Vampires have been exposed to the world… and you’re one of them. Seize the night as a modern monster, stepping out of the shadows to build a thriving nightclub empire through fear, seduction, and forbidden supernatural gifts. Your second life begins tonight...

item.title: Rivage
item.description: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

item.title: STUNTBOOST
item.description: Blast through cardboard tracks, master your momentum and shave off milliseconds to earn medals and challenge friends on a fingerboard with no speed limit.

item.title: Well Dweller
item.description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

item.title: Airport Control 27
item.description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

item.title: Deified
item.description: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

item.title: Galvatein : Adventurers' Guild
item.description: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

item.title: Call to Arms
item.description: Call to Arms offers an innovative mix of real-time strategy and 3rd, as well as 1st person controls. Set in the time of modern warfare, the game offers realistically modeled vehicles and heavy weaponry. Command your troops to victory or fight by yourself in the 3rd or 1st person action mode.

item.title: Undusted: Letters from the Past
item.description: Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game in which you clean and restore dirty items. What is her story as she returns to a long-neglected house? Enjoy the satisfying audiovisuals featuring sensually designed sounds and graphics.

item.title: Ved: Recure
item.description: "Ved: Recure" is a fast-paced action roguelite where you find yourself trapped inside the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

item.title: Brave New Wonders
item.description: Automate, optimize, and build vast factories in a post-apocalyptic automation game for those who have evolved beyond conveyor belts. Command intelligent robots that obey your plain-text commands in any language, explore the ruins of a lost civilization, and rebuild humanity one machine at a time.

item.title: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Airborne
item.description: Re-live the legendary operations of the 82nd and 101st US airborne divisions. This DLC offers a new immersive single-player format which takes you from the first para drops in Normandy through Market Garden, the battle of the Bulge and the crossing of the Elbe River.

item.title: Delverium
item.description: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this survival sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Delve deep to uncover the secret of the invading 'Faults' and restore stability to the land.

item.title: Escape Simulator 2: Apocalypse DLC
item.description: The Apocalypse DLC adds 4 new escape rooms set in a near-future world devastated by an unknown catastrophe. Civilization has gone quiet. Cities are overgrown, systems are failing, and the only way forward is through the clues left by those who came before you.

item.title: Lorn's Lure
item.description: An android is led through a vast structure by a glitch in his visual system. Lorn's Lure is an atmospheric narrative first-person platformer with novel climb-anything mechanics and modernized retro 3D graphics.

item.title: Normal Golf Game
item.description: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.

item.title: Remnant: From the Ashes - Subject 2923
item.description: Complete new quests and conquer unique bosses to acquire additional gear, increasing your chances of surviving the rugged wilderness of Earth and beyond, as you aim to put an end to the Root and restore humanity.

item.title: Remnant: From the Ashes - Swamps of Corsus
item.description: Begin your journey across the dangerous and corrupted worlds of Remnant: From the Ashes with a new mode and expanded map content in the Swamps of Corsus DLC.

item.title: Roadhouse Simulator
item.description: Pour beer, break up brawls, distill your own liquor, run pig races, deal with gangs and keep the cops off your back as you turn a rundown Route 66 bar into one hell of a Road House.

item.title: Deadshot
item.description: You wake up as an army soldier in the middle of a mutant apocalypse, trying to figure out what the hell happened and blasting some heads on the way. Deadshot is a retro styled first person shooter inspired from classics like Half Life, Doom, Quake and many alike.

item.title: Dying Light: The Beast - Discharge Weapon Pack
item.description: Embrace the storm with Discharge, an electrifying machete salvaged from the heart of Harran. Designed as a tool of destruction, its charged blade crackles with untamed energy, cleaving through the Infected with a visceral thrill.

item.title: Space Menace
item.description: Space Menace is a sci-fi space RTS and battle game. You play as a space captain, seeking fortune and glory as you see fit. Leave your mark on the world and determine the fate of the galaxy with your decisions.
